scope: Reference ORIGINAL/CE behavior must be recorded independently of Vampiro adaptation expectations; no overall acceptance inferred from an audit.
geometry_policy: No literal translation of square C cell IDs to hex Fallout MAP coordinates.

cases.preconditions: Empty ground; native geometry and camera recorded.
cases.stimulus: Project/unproject representative cell centers and choose each native direction.
cases.expected_vampiro: Selected node equals intended node; equal logical distances have comparable durations; C cardinal 300 ms, diagonal 425 ms is adaptation policy, not CE expectation.

cases.preconditions: Crate, wall, dumpster and actor registered with footprints.
cases.stimulus: Request destination inside each solid; walk around each edge.
cases.expected_vampiro: No route or execution traverses covered cells; decorated surfaces designated nonblocking remain walkable.

cases.preconditions: Actor moves with partially completed segment.
cases.stimulus: Redirect at 150 ms and repeatedly before arrival; cancel using Escape.
cases.expected_vampiro: No position discontinuity; previous interaction cancelled; last valid destination wins at next node. Record original/CE behavior separately from proposed C policy.

cases.preconditions: Actor approaches target along existing route.
cases.stimulus: Block a future segment, keeping current reserved segment clear.
cases.expected_vampiro: Revalidate before entering; reroute once per relevant map change or stop with reason; no retries per render frame.

cases.preconditions: Locked door; key not owned, then key owned.
cases.stimulus: Use door; cancel before effect; resume; cross only after declared opening moment.
cases.expected_vampiro: No opening without key/contact; no body/leaf overlap; open state and passage agree; repeat no duplicate effect.

cases.preconditions: Two overlapping perceived objects; one object behind opaque wall.
cases.stimulus: Point at each visible piece and right-click inspect; click wall, then free ground.
cases.expected_vampiro: Visible front object selected; hidden object not disclosed; wall click does not become movement through wall; world text references same ID.

cases.preconditions: Tall wall, wide dumpster and elevated decoration.
cases.stimulus: Walk fixed perimeter in both directions; pass near wall-mounted pieces.
cases.expected_vampiro: Feet and body stay coherent with volume; front/back occlusion follows extent, not merely center sort; video mandatory.

cases.preconditions: Unique ground item within reachable contact.
cases.stimulus: Use; cancel before effect; use again; cancel after effect; resend same action.
cases.expected_vampiro: Item stays ground before effect and is owned once after effect; rendering cannot decide transfer; reference action-frame measured.

cases.preconditions: Movement and pending redirected intent; action in pre/post-effect phases.
cases.stimulus: Save/load at each boundary and compare with uninterrupted input trace.
cases.expected_vampiro: Segment, intent, phase, receipts and future work match; no teleport or duplicate effect; namespace/version explicit.

cases.preconditions: Target near actor but wall separates contact point.
cases.stimulus: Attempt talk/use/feed; alter target availability while approaching.
cases.expected_vampiro: No action through barrier; permissions/contact rechecked at effect; no acquisition or resource debit on rejection.

cases.preconditions: Same authority input trace; different render rates or hidden window.
cases.stimulus: Measure at two render rates; pause through declared campaign operation.
cases.expected_vampiro: Gameplay results follow logical clock; FPS/visibility do not define random draws or resource transfers. Explicit pause halts campaign work consistently.

cases.preconditions: Untouched C v1 historical map/save and separate A/B saves.
cases.stimulus: Load historical save in historical runner; attempt loading it in new namespace.
cases.expected_vampiro: Historical runner retains semantics; new laboratory explicitly rejects incompatible version without silently rewriting history or changing current world.

trace_scope: Numerical trace A2-03 is the proposed square-grid adaptation profile, not an observed Fallout trace; other geometry uses native equivalents.
